- todo       → in_progress | complete
- in_progress → in_review | complete
- in_review  → in_progress | complete

and (if `pointsAwarded` is provided) the points are recorded.

Unified endpoint to add a course to the authenticated user's profile.
The `file` field is optional — if omitted, the course is created with
no certificate and you can attach one later via
`/user/upload/course-certificate/{courseIndex}`. If the certificate
upload fails, the course is NOT created (atomic — no orphan course
pointing at a missing file).

patch.description:
Updates the course at `courseIndex` in the authenticated user's
`courses` array. Both fields are optional — send only what changes.
Replacing the certificate uploads the new asset first and destroys
the old Cloudinary file afterwards, so a failed upload leaves the
course untouched. Returns 404 when no course exists at that index.

file.description: Replacement certificate — image or PDF, max 2 MB (optional)

certificateUrl.description: Authenticated file-proxy URL (PDF certificates only); fetch it with the bearer token to open the PDF inline, same as the CV/resume.

get.summary: Proxy a Cloudinary file with correct Content-Type
get.description:
Serves a raw Cloudinary asset (PDF, doc, image) with the right
Content-Type header so browsers can open it inline. Requires a
valid bearer token, the `url` query param must point to a
resource in the configured Cloudinary cloud, redirects are
refused, and the response is capped at 10 MB.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Filename with extension (e.g. `resume.pdf`). The extension determines the Content-Type.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Fully-encoded Cloudinary URL of the file to fetch.

200.description: File body streamed with the correct Content-Type.

400.description: Missing/invalid `url` or `url` does not target the configured Cloudinary cloud.
